set: Pirate Shipwreck dressing kit wave 1.1 (kit_v1_1) - kit_v1 + 7 revised meshes
orientation: origin at base centre at ground level, front faces +Z, Y up; FBX export axis_forward=-Z axis_up=Y scale 1
scenery_note: ALL meshes are scenery only: set CanCollide=false (and CanQuery/CanTouch false), Anchored=true. None are gameplay surfaces.
colour: palette-texture: one 256px palette PNG (8x8 cells), per-vertex UVs at cell centres, Closest filtering; no vertex colours; no skulls or gore

previews.note: 3q previews of changed meshes are in previews_kit_v1_1/; unchanged ones are in ../kit_v1/previews_kit_v1/

deviations: Rocks and hull rib are buried: bottom below y=0 by design (rock_s -1.17, rock_m -1.99, rock_l -2.57, hull_rib -2.07); y=0 is the ground line.
Lean palms (a,b) are pivoted at the trunk base, not the bbox centre. lean_a leans toward +Z, lean_b toward +X.
vine_arch is ~46 wide overall (arch itself spans ~34; foot ferns and leaves add width) vs 30-40 target.
stack_b is 408 wide x 190 tall (a broad island); stack_a 320 tall, stack_c 390 tall.
Sizes are procedural estimates; palm and stack sizes may be scaled in Studio.
v1_1: kit_vine_arch rose to ~4.1k tris (leaf mass doubled plus extra vines), over the 1-3k undergrowth target but far under 20k; width still ~45 (arch ~34).
v1_1: rocks shrank in footprint (plate was the widest piece): rock_s 10.8, rock_m 18.1, rock_l 34.5 wide. Their sandy dome caps remain, so rock tops still read tan.
v1_1: reef_ring is ~274 x 255 (wobbly outline) and 14.4 tall (rocks poking through).
v1_1: stacks a/c are now ~302 x 257 and ~227 x 194 at the base.

kit_palm_s.suggested_use: Short palm for beach pads (target ~25 high).

kit_palm_m.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_palm_m.suggested_use: Medium palm, shoulders the pad palms (target ~40 high).

kit_palm_l.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_palm_l.suggested_use: Tall palm for skyline and jungle edges (target ~60 high).

kit_palm_lean_a.pivot: trunk base at x=z=0, y=0 (lean palm: placed by its trunk)
kit_palm_lean_a.suggested_use: Leaning palm: crown leans toward +Z (front). Origin is the trunk base.

kit_palm_lean_b.pivot: trunk base at x=z=0, y=0 (lean palm: placed by its trunk)
kit_palm_lean_b.suggested_use: Leaning palm: crown leans toward +X. Origin is the trunk base.

kit_rock_s.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0; y=0 is the ground line, bottom intentionally sits below ground (sinks into terrain)
kit_rock_s.suggested_use: Small half-buried rock cluster for pad corners and waterline.

kit_rock_m.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0; y=0 is the ground line, bottom intentionally sits below ground (sinks into terrain)
kit_rock_m.suggested_use: Medium half-buried rock cluster for the beach and jungle banks.

kit_rock_l.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0; y=0 is the ground line, bottom intentionally sits below ground (sinks into terrain)
kit_rock_l.suggested_use: Large half-buried rock cluster for headlands and cave approach.

kit_leafclump.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_leafclump.suggested_use: Big-leaf jungle plant (taro/banana style) for the jungle trail and pad corners.

kit_fernclump.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_fernclump.suggested_use: Low fern clump to break up bare ground; scatter 3-5 per pad corner.

kit_vine_strip.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_vine_strip.suggested_use: Hanging vine curtain (about 22 wide, 25 tall) for jungle canopy edges; hang from a branch or canopy mass.

kit_vine_arch.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_vine_arch.suggested_use: Vine arch spanning a path (about 36 wide, 16 high). Path runs along Z; arch spans X. One every ~40 studs on the jungle trail.

kit_planks.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_planks.suggested_use: Broken plank pile for the beach debris trail from the wreck.

kit_barrel.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_barrel.suggested_use: Barrel for the beach, pad 1 and the wreck deck.

kit_crate.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_crate.suggested_use: Wooden crate pair for the beach and wreck deck.

kit_rope_coil.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_rope_coil.suggested_use: Coiled rope for the wreck deck and beach.

kit_spar_snapped.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_spar_snapped.suggested_use: Snapped mast spar resting on a rock, with a lashed yard piece, for the beach and wreck.

kit_hull_rib.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0; y=0 is the ground line, bottom intentionally sits below ground (sinks into terrain)
kit_hull_rib.suggested_use: Half-buried hull ribs arching out of sand (bottom 2 studs are meant to sink below the ground line).

kit_stack_a.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_stack_a.suggested_use: Tall hazy sea-stack spire group for the skyline (about 320 high). Place 400-900 studs out; fog friendly.

kit_stack_b.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_stack_b.suggested_use: Broad hazy mesa island with twin tops for the skyline (about 190 high).

kit_stack_c.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_stack_c.suggested_use: Tall leaning twin-fin sea stack (about 390 high) for the horizon.

kit_reef_ring.pivot: bbox centre x/z at 0, base at y=0
kit_reef_ring.suggested_use: Offshore reef ring (about 270 across, uneven outline) with a light-turquoise shallow band, coral bumps and a few rocks poking through; sits on the water surface, y=0 is the water line.

unchanged_meshes: 15 other meshes are byte-identical copies of kit_v1 (FBX and PNG).
palette_note: kit_palette.png now has 7 appended colours (StackRock/Dk/Lt, Shallow, ShallowLt, Coral, CoralLt). Existing cells did not move. The 7 changed meshes embed the v1_1 palette; the 15 unchanged keep the v1 palette PNG (their cells are identical).

v1_1_changes.stacks: stack_a and stack_c: base ~1.6x wider (x/z positions and radii x1.6), blunt weathered flat-topped tips, rock warmed to StackRock tones (138,121,108 / 112,98,88 / 160,142,127), green tops lowered (cap from ~0.62-0.76 of height) to read like stack_b.
v1_1_changes.reef_ring: uneven wobbly outline (radius modulated 2/3/5 lobes), light turquoise Shallow (112,218,204) and ShallowLt (168,238,226) bands around the ridge, 30 uneven coral/rock bumps incl. peach coral, 5 taller rocks poking through with sandy caps.
v1_1_changes.vine_arch: 44 leaf blades along the arch (was 22), 11 hanging vines (was 7, longer, clamped to stay >=2.5 studs above ground).
v1_1_changes.rocks: base plate dome removed from rock_s/m/l; only the rock domes with sandy caps remain.
